components.label: Description
components.quote: FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT (Influenza Vaccine) is a subunit influenza vaccine manufactured using cell derived candidate vaccine viruses (CVV) that are propagated in Madin Darby Canine Kidney (MDCK) cells, a continuous cell line.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each dose of FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT may contain residual amounts of MDCK cell protein (≤ 25.2 mcg), protein other than HA (≤ 240 mcg), MDCK cell DNA (≤ 10 ng), polysorbate 80 (≤ 1500 mcg), cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (≤ 18 mcg), and β-propiolactone (< 0.5 mcg), which are used in the manufacturing process.

allergens.quote: FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT contains no egg protein or antibiotics.
FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT contains no egg protein or antibiotics.

allergens.quote: The tip caps and plungers of the pre-filled syringes and the multi-dose vial stopper are not made with natural rubber latex.

Each dose of FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT may contain residual amounts of MDCK cell protein (≤ 25.2 mcg), protein other than HA (≤ 240 mcg), MDCK cell DNA (≤ 10 ng), polysorbate 80 (≤ 1500 mcg), cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (≤ 18 mcg), and β-propiolactone (< 0.5 mcg), which are used in the manufacturing process.
FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT 5 mL multi-dose vials contain thimerosal, a mercury derivative, added as a preservative.
allergens.note: 僅多劑量瓶含硫柳汞；0.5 mL 預充針劑無防腐劑（同頁另有 'FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT 0.5 mL pre-filled syringes contain no preservative.'）

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Do not administer FLUCELVAX QUADRIVALENT to anyone with a history of severe allergic reaction (e.g. anaphylaxis) to any component of the vaccine [see Description (11)].
